timedEngineTotal: sum of complete timed API batches across every scored case; no synthetic weights or post-hoc exclusions

runtimeDefaults.refill: Restore fixed stocks and empty eligible destinations outside timing after each verified frame

environment.optionalMods: identical, with legacy SFM compatibility disabled in both synthetic arms

transfer.text:
NAME "common_transfer"
EVERY 1 TICKS DO
  INPUT FROM source
  OUTPUT TO dest
END

witness.text:
NAME "common_witness"
EVERY 1 TICKS DO
  INPUT FROM source
  OUTPUT TO dest
  FORGET
  INPUT FROM witness
  OUTPUT TO witness_out
END

condition.text:
NAME "common_condition"
EVERY 1 TICKS DO
  IF OVERALL source HAS > 1000 sfm_bench:keep THEN
    INPUT FROM witness
    OUTPUT TO true_out
  ELSE
    INPUT FROM witness
    OUTPUT TO false_out
  END
END
